decision.explanation: The query asks for the birth date of Justice Ritchie (Roland Almon Ritchie). Two distinct source documents provide conflicting dates for the same individual: Document 1 (D1S1) states 'June 19, 1910', while Document 2 (D2S1) states 'January 1, 1900'. Both documents explicitly identify the subject as the same 'Canadian lawyer and puisne justice of the Supreme Court of Canada' with the same death date (June 5, 1988). Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers when competing assertions exist without external resolution, both dates are included as they represent distinct claims found in the provided source material.
